derived_from.rule: The A warm-up reuses the B R2-U2 head-only warm-up recipe. The train block must equal the B one (owner, model name and protocol excluded); the loader compares them and refuses any difference. The head is trained on A training crops only.

model.name: ast_frozen
model.frozen: the whole backbone, parameters and buffers, in eval mode

selection.metric: recording macro F1 at fixed threshold 0.5

pretrained_group_sha256: taken from configs/r3_u2_ast_ft_b.json init.pretrained_group_sha256 (14 groups); the loader refuses a backbone that differs

decisions.authority: REVISED_PLAN.md Phase R4: AST-A is a warm-up followed by partial fine-tuning with the B recipe. The user chose on 15 November 2026 a fresh warm-up on Protocol A rather than the B warm-up checkpoint. Nothing below differs from the B warm-up recipe. The project owner reported on 15 November 2026 that the team agreed on this recipe (status team_agreed_user_reported_2026-11-15); no individual approval record exists in the repository. The training command refuses a recipe whose status does not start with team_agreed.
decisions.scope: One seeded four-second crop per A training recording per epoch (7,550 recordings, all five components); selection-role chunks for checkpoint choice; no calibration, operating or test audio.
decisions.checkpoint: best.pt by selection recording macro F1 at 0.5, earliest epoch on ties; it is the initializer of the A fine-tune and the epoch-0 reference of the paired comparison.
